query: How frequently in 2026 has Russia launched overnight drone barrages against Ukraine exceeding 600 drones in a single night? List specific dates and drone counts for the largest barrages in May, June, and early July 2026 according to Ukrainian Air Force figures.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary of my findings on Russian overnight drone barrages exceeding 600 drones against Ukraine in 2026:

## Key Findings

**Frequency of 600+ drone nights in 2026 (through July 15):**
- **May 2026:** 4 days (record month — 8,161 total UAVs launched)
- **June 2026:** 2 nights (tempo dropped ~30% to 5,749 total UAVs)
- **Early July 2026:** 0 nights (largest was 496 drones)

**Largest barrages by month:**

| Date | Drones | Combined weapons | Notes |
|------|--------|------------------|-------|
| **May 13–14** | 675 overnight / **1,567 total** | +56 missiles | Largest attack of the war; 27 killed |
| **June 2** (night of Jun 1–2) | **656** | 729 (+73 missiles) | Largest combined assault of war at the time; ≥22 killed |
| **June 15** (night of Jun 14–15) | **611** | 681 (+70 missiles) | ≥11 killed |
| **July 1–2** | 496 (below 600) | 570 (+74 missiles) | Deadliest Kyiv attack since May |

**Notable nuance:** The measurement depends on how a "night" is defined. Ukrainian Air Force figures count total UAVs launched (Shahed/Geran strike drones + Gerbera, Italmas, Banderol, and Parodiya decoys) per reporting window. Per the ISIS analysis of Ukrainian Air Force data, only **two June nights** and **no early-July nights** exceeded 600 drones — early July's largest (July 1–2) reached only 496 drones despite being highly lethal. The single largest 2026 barrage was the May 13–14 sequence.

All findings are sourced to Ukrainian Air Force reporting (via ISIS monthly Shahed reports, ISW, ANTIKOR, UNITED24, Defense Express, and major wire services).

sources.snippet: June 2026 marked a clear break: Russia launched 5,749 Shahed-type UAVs (down from May record 8,161). Only two June days exceeded 600 UAVs: June 2 (656) and June 15 (611).

sources.title: 14 May 2026 Russian strikes on Ukraine
sources.snippet: During the night of 13-14 May 2026, Russia conducted its largest aerial attack of the war: 1,567 drones and 56 missiles. 27 civilians killed (24 in Kyiv).

sources.snippet: 753 drones 08:00-18:30 May 13; at least 675 more overnight into May 14; total at least 1,428 over 24 hours.

sources.title: Record attack with 729 targets: Air defence shot down 40 missiles and 602 drones
sources.snippet: Night of June 2: Air Force detected 729 assets - 73 missiles and 656 UAVs. Air defense downed 642 (40 missiles, 602 UAVs).

sources.title: 729 Drones and Missiles Hit Ukraine
sources.snippet: Overnight 1-2 June 2026: 729 weapons (656 drones + 73 missiles); largest single assault since full-scale invasion at the time; at least 22 killed.

sources.title: Russia fired 681 weapons at Ukraine on June 15. Air defense stopped the cheap ones.
sources.snippet: Russia launched 70 missiles and 611 drones into June 15; air defenses downed 632 of 681; at least 11 killed.

sources.title: Nearly 700 attack assets: Russia launches unprecedented combined attack on Ukraine
sources.snippet: Night of June 15: 681 assets - 70 missiles and 611 UAVs; air defense neutralized 632 (50 of 70 missiles, 582 of 611 drones).

sources.title: Ukraine Intercepts Nearly 96% of Russian Drones in Massive 570-Target Attack
sources.snippet: July 2: Russia launched 570 weapons (74 missiles + 496 drones); air defenses downed 524 (48 missiles, 476 drones).

sources.title: 21 dead after massive Russian overnight assault in Ukraine

sources.title: Russia attacked Ukraine with 2 missiles, 101 out of 122 drones neutralized
sources.snippet: Night of July 15: Russia launched 2 missiles and 122 drones; 101 UAVs shot down/suppressed.

sources.snippet: Russian drone volumes fell to 5,749 in June (92% intercepted) from all-time monthly record of ~8,150 in May.
